indexLead: The wording {brand} trades on, written around how this catalogue actually works: we sell Counter-Strike 2 items and hand each one over by {method} once the payment is confirmed.
indexMetaDescription: Terms, privacy, cookies, refunds, Steam delivery, payment, the item guarantee, complaints and acceptable use at {brand}.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.scope: The agreement between you and {company} whenever you buy something from {brand}.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.scope: The personal data we hold, our reasons for holding it, who else processes it and what you can ask us to do.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.scope: Every cookie and browser storage key this store writes, and how to change what you allowed.

returns.title: Refunds
returns.scope: When an item is refunded, how the right to cancel works before delivery starts, and how the money comes back.

shipping.title: Delivery via Steam
shipping.scope: How each trade offer is sent, what your Steam account must be able to do, trade protection and failed deliveries.

payment.title: Payment
payment.scope: Which cards and currencies we take, how card details are handled and the moment your card is charged.

warranty.title: Item guarantee
warranty.scope: A refund when an item is not delivered inside {hours} hours or Steam reverses the trade.

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.scope: How to put a complaint to us, how fast we answer and where you can take it afterwards.

acceptable-use.title: Acceptable use
acceptable-use.scope: What you may and may not do with this website, your account and the Steam account linked to it.
